zd.summe: Open reminders due by the coalition review on {datum}: {n}. If they expire unanswered, the weakest chair’s loyalty falls from {vor} to {nach}.
zd.bruch: This would put the chair below 20. At the monthly review, this partner could withdraw {sitze} government seats, leaving {rest}.
zd.puffer: These known expirations alone do not cross the breakup threshold. Other political effects can use up the remaining buffer.
zd.schritt: Address “{zusage}” first: fulfil it or review the cost of postponing it before the day changes to {datum}. A conversation does not close the reminder.
zd.antworten: Respond to the most urgent reminder
zd.details: The {n} affected reminders and their deadlines
zd.frist: Expires when the day changes to {datum}
zd.grenze: Conditional calculation using already open reminders, including those expiring on review day. Unopened reminders, future votes, conversations and other monthly effects are not projected. Nothing is deducted today.
